answer: Treat every new identity like a boat arriving at a jetty: it may dock only by posting a bond and doing verifiable work for established agents before it earns any reward. The bond is released only after three independent attestations, and a caught cheat forfeits it. Honest newcomers pay once, but a Sybil farm must fund a bond and work for every clone, so its cost grows with each fake. The limit: a funded attacker can still buy a small island of fakes, so the bond must rise steeply when one sponsor backs many newcomers, and no newcomer may vote until it reaches the summit of the trust ladder.
